title: Amaranthium (Duality)
description:
A mod for my cousins, all about item (mostly weapon) pairs, to represent Duality, the chaos, and rivalry of elements.
(Discloser: Not all elements listed in mod have been used.)
body:
This mod is all about duality, and based of the chaotic, rival-like brothership of my cousins, which are chaotic, and parallel, but are overpowered when they work together.
here is a poem, that you will only beable to read in the mod under certain, difficlt conditions, and it is all jumbled at that point, here is it un-jumbler --> "Feathers drift through ashen skies, Their golden glow now cold and dim. A star once bright in heaven’s eyes, Falls silent where the light grows grim.  The burning blade slips from his hand, His voice, once thunder, fades to mist. No more to guard at fate’s command, He sinks into the abyss’ kiss."
There is a list of 'Elements' that parallel to each other, but not all of them are actually used in my mod (I think), here they Are:
Fire - Water
Fire - Ice
Water - Poison
Lightning - Plant
Earth - Air
Sand - Air
Metal - Sound
Air - Void
Lava - Water
Lava - Ice
Darkness - Light
Horror - Bliss
I apologise, but Poison is not used.
Please, for your own sake, use JEI/REI
Anyone who wants to make an addon for this mod can if they wish.
